question: Is the software free to use?
answer: Yes. scout4all is completely free and open source (AGPL-3.0). Anyone can help improve it, suggest features or report problems on GitHub.

question: I was using the terminal version. What happens now?
answer: Nothing to do: at its next start, the terminal version offers to update, and the update installs the desktop app in its place. Your teams and matches are in the same folder and you will find them all. From then on, starting scout4all opens a window instead of the terminal interface.

question: Why is scouting done from the keyboard?
answer: Speed. A rally lasts a few seconds: with a key for each event, player and evaluation, your eyes stay on the court and you can keep up with the game. Every key can be changed in the settings. Scouting can be done with a mouse or touchpad too.

question: Can I record the zones of play?
answer: Yes. For serves, receptions, attacks, digs and blocks you can mark the zone of the court involved. For attacks you can also record the number of players at the block. This information is optional: you can leave it out and just evaluate the touch.

question: Are all player positions and attack zones customizable?
answer: Not all of them: the app makes some consistent choices to keep data entry quick. The libero always replaces the middle blocker in the back row (except when the middle blocker serves), and the attack zones follow from the roles and the position of the setter. You can declare an inverted P1 and a reception with two, three or four players.

question: Can I open matches scouted with DataVolley?
answer: Yes: import a .dvw file into one of your teams, with its zones. The imported match is analysed like the others, alone or across several matches.

question: How often is it updated? Do I need to install updates manually?
answer: It is under active development and new versions come out regularly. You don't need to download them yourself: at every start the app checks for a new version and, after asking you, installs it and restarts.

question: The application no longer starts after an automatic update. What happened?
answer: Up to version 0.4.2, the automatic update could replace the application with a data file published alongside each release (the software bill of materials) instead of the new version. This is fixed since version 0.4.3. To recover, download the latest version again from the downloads and replace the old file. Your teams and matches are stored separately and are not affected.
